indexes.name: class_live_one_open_class_per_session
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX class_live_one_open_class_per_session ON public.class_live_sessions USING btree (session_id) WHERE is_open

indexes.name: class_live_sessions_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX class_live_sessions_pkey ON public.class_live_sessions USING btree (class_id)

triggers.name: close_class_entry_on_session_end
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER close_class_entry_on_session_end AFTER UPDATE OF is_active ON public.quick_play_sessions FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.is_active AND (NOT new.is_active))) EXECUTE FUNCTION close_class_entry_on_session_end()

functions.name: close_class_entry_on_session_end

functions.body:
SELECT c.id, c.name, s.id, s.session_code, s.allowed_modes,
    CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN link.expires_at END
  FROM public.classes c
  JOIN public.users u ON u.class_code = c.code AND u.uid = (SELECT auth.uid())::text
  JOIN public.student_profiles p ON p.auth_uid::text = u.uid
    AND p.class_code = c.code AND p.status = 'approved'
  LEFT JOIN public.class_live_sessions link ON link.class_id = c.id
    AND c.teacher_uid = link.teacher_uid AND link.is_open AND link.expires_at > now()
  LEFT JOIN public.quick_play_sessions s ON s.id = link.session_id
    AND s.teacher_uid = c.teacher_uid AND s.is_active = true
    AND coalesce(c.subject, 'english') = coalesce(s.subject, 'english')
  WHERE u.role = 'student'
  LIMIT 1;
functions.name: get_my_live_class_session
functions.returns: TABLE(class_id uuid, class_name text, session_id uuid, session_code text, allowed_modes text[], expires_at timestamp with time zone)
